findings.value: A family-run Italian and British café on Bethnal Green Road, serving since 1900, with a Grade II listed interior.

evidence.quote: Here since 1900, still serving fierce fry-ups
We are an authentic Italian family cafe established in 1900
Our beautiful interior, created in the early 1940’s by family friend and local genius carpenter Achille Capocci was awarded Grade 2 listing status in 2007.

notes: Time Out review (undated on the page) and the venue's own story page read. Time Out's review says the venue has a Grade II listing and a Kray-era history; not used for crowd. No music or closing news found. The café's evening cocktail nights are for the programme researcher. WebSearch was unavailable this run.
